## Featured Projects
- **Akora UI**: A premium, accessible React component library and design system designed for modern, high-performance web applications. Built with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.

- **Portfolio Website**: A sleek, modern portfolio built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
